source.mappingAuthority: SRS chapter 5.2; engineering changes explicitly documented

columns.name: total_credit_required
columns.description: Credit total needed for graduation under this curriculum.

columns.name: effective_year
columns.description: Optional year in which this curriculum takes effect.

columns.name: subject_code
columns.description: Unique subject code in the current ERD.

columns.name: credit_hours
columns.description: Credit value assigned to the subject.

columns.name: include_in_offering_forecast
columns.description: Controls inclusion in M6 class-section recommendations; FALSE for FYP1, FYP2 and Industrial Training.

columns.name: class_type
columns.description: LECTURE or LAB for M6 capacity rules; future combined teaching components may require a separate mapping.

columns.name: is_compulsory
columns.description: Compulsory-subject flag (0 or 1 in the current ERD).

columns.name: subject_category
columns.description: Subject classification within the applicable curriculum.

columns.name: required_credits
columns.description: Optional minimum credits for this requirement.

columns.name: required_subjects
columns.description: Optional minimum number of subjects in this requirement.

columns.name: curriculum_id
columns.description: References Curriculum; name retained exactly from the ERD.

columns.name: requirement_type
columns.description: Type of prerequisite or associated requirement.

columns.name: max_subjects
columns.description: Configured subject-count limit for the semester.

columns.name: max_credits
columns.description: Configured credit limit for the semester.

columns.name: start_date
columns.description: Optional starting date of the semester.

columns.name: end_date
columns.description: Optional ending date of the semester.

columns.name: clerk_user_id
columns.description: Unique authenticated user identifier supplied by Clerk.

columns.name: available_study_hours
columns.description: Optional self-reported study time per week.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description: Date/time the profile was last updated.

columns.name: status
columns.description: Subject status: completed, exempted, failed or withdrawn.

columns.name: recognized_credits
columns.description: Credits recognized for graduation; may be zero.

columns.name: remarks
columns.description: Optional exemption or academic record notes.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Date/time the reported offering was created.

columns.name: semester_id
columns.description: AcademicSemester to which the offering applies.

columns.name: plan_name
columns.description: Optional name assigned to the plan.

columns.name: plan_type
columns.description: Plan type, such as student-selected or recommended.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description: Date/time the plan was last updated.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Date/time the plan-subject entry was created.

columns.name: semester_id
columns.description: References AcademicSemester for the planned subject.

columns.name: source_plan_id
columns.description: Optional baseline AcademicPlan used for comparison.

columns.name: remarks
columns.description: Optional explanation of the hypothetical change.

columns.name: proposed_semester_id
columns.description: Optional AcademicSemester proposed for the change.

columns.name: source_label
columns.description: Origin and description of provided academic data

columns.name: is_synthetic
columns.description: Distinguish generated histories from real source records

columns.name: is_active
columns.description: Whether rule is currently in force

columns.name: scenario_assumptions
columns.description: Assumed pass rates and uncertain data handling

columns.name: status
columns.description: Draft / Under Review / Finalized / Superseded / Archived

columns.name: learning_centre_id
columns.description: Centre for version-number uniqueness and filtering

columns.name: parent_forecast_run_id
columns.description: Previous version; nullable for first run

columns.name: finalized_at
columns.description: Finalization time; locks stored results and decisions

columns.name: eligible_count
columns.description: Verified count if sufficient data exists

columns.name: review_status
columns.description: Current section review status; all changes are recorded in ForecastDecisionAuditLog

columns.name: clerk_user_id
columns.description: Clerk identity reference; application stores no password.

columns.name: access_assignment_id
columns.description: Account access record whose role or status changed.
